waivers.scope: Transport confidentiality (lattice mTLS) not verified; no wasmCloud runtime available
waivers.risk: High: a network observer could read topology if the lattice is misconfigured
waivers.compensating_controls: PKT1 message MACs prevent forgery; audit; per-site deployment
waivers.remediation: Pin and verify wasmCloud host + NATS TLS; integration run in lattice

waivers.scope: Release manifest signed with an ephemeral NONPRODUCTION key
waivers.risk: High: signature proves integrity only against this key, not organisational identity
waivers.compensating_controls: SHA-256 manifest + SBOM + provenance published; verify tool fails closed on mismatch
waivers.remediation: Sign with the organisation's controlled release key; publish key + rotation procedure

waivers.risk: Medium: unknown energy cost on constrained devices (devices do not run the authority)
waivers.compensating_controls: Authority runs on site gateways only; CPU cost measured
waivers.remediation: Measure on reference gateway hardware with RAPL/thermal sensors

waivers.scope: No multi-hour soak or fleet-scale run
waivers.risk: Medium: slow leaks or fleet effects unobserved
waivers.compensating_controls: Every cache bounded; overload + 5-cycle partition tests
waivers.remediation: 24 h soak and 1 000-site fleet simulation in staging

waivers.risk: High: the series' own gate not executed
waivers.compensating_controls: Repository-local RTM + 16 CI lanes; adapter exits 2 without pk_core
waivers.remediation: Vendor/pin pk_core and run the gate; archive evidence

waivers.scope: Idempotency store is memory-only and evicts oldest entries when full (50 000); a retry after restart or eviction within TTL could re-apply
waivers.risk: Low: a retry after eviction within TTL could re-apply
waivers.compensating_controls: Mutations are CAS-able via expected_revision; capacity well above expected rate
waivers.remediation: Persist idempotency keys in the WAL

waivers.risk: Medium: requirements derived from checklists, not the original master
waivers.compensating_controls: Requirements traced to CHECKLIST.json and the MC checklist
waivers.remediation: Obtain master source from series owner
